Singularity — vitalezzz
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/singularity-0
Source license checked: 14 November 2026

The artist lists both the calm and action versions under Creative Commons Zero
(CC0 1.0 Universal). The page identifies the work as “Vitalezzz - Singularity”.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

This project uses the calm version for menus and a synchronized 60% calm / 40%
action mix for gameplay. Both are normalized and encoded as 96 kbps MP3.
See ../CREDITS.txt for source URLs and normalization details.
